doc.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been really fascinating talking to you.
Well it’s fascinating to talk to you. My God, you made it so nice and comfortable for me.
I might just sit right here for the rest of the day.
I hope to get to hear you play sometime.
I hope so. I think we’ll keep in touch and if I ever come up your way I’ll give you a call.
Okay. I hope you make it to the Turning Stone too.
I will. And I thank you very much.
